targetInterval.doc: Ticks between attempt at finding a target.

newTargetInterval.doc: Target interval for when this turret already has a valid target. -1 = targetInterval

consumeAmmoOnce.doc: If true, ammo is only consumed once per shot regardless of bullet count.

heatRequirement.doc: Minimum input heat required to fire.

maxHeatEfficiency.doc: Maximum efficiency possible, if this turret uses heat.

velocityRnd.doc: Fraction of bullet velocity that is random.

scaleLifetimeOffset.doc: Fraction of lifetime that is added to bullets with lifeScale.

shootCone.doc: Maximum angle difference in degrees at which turret will still try to shoot.

xRand.doc: Random spread on the X axis.

drawMinRange.doc: If true, a range ring is also drawn for minRange.

trackingRange.doc: Range at which it finds and locks on to the target, but does not shoot.

minRange.doc: Minimum bullet range. Used for artillery only.

accurateDelay.doc: If true, this turret will accurately target moving targets with respect to shoot.firstShotDelay.

moveWhileCharging.doc: If false, this turret can't move while charging.

reloadWhileCharging.doc: If false, this turret can't reload while charging

warmupMaintainTime.doc: How long warmup is maintained even if this turret isn't shooting.

targetAir.doc: If true, this block targets air units.

targetGround.doc: If true, this block targets ground units and structures.

targetBlocks.doc: If true, this block targets blocks.

targetHealing.doc: If true, this block targets friend blocks, to heal them.

playerControllable.doc: If true, this turret can be controlled by players.

displayAmmoMultiplier.doc: If true, this block will display ammo multipliers in its stats (irrelevant for certain types of turrets).

targetUnderBlocks.doc: If false, 'under' blocks like conveyors are not targeted.

alwaysShooting.doc: If true, the turret will always shoot when it has ammo, regardless of targets in range or any control.

predictTarget.doc: Whether this turret predicts unit movement.

unitSort.doc: Function for choosing which unit to target.

unitFilter.doc: Filter for types of units to attack.

buildingFilter.doc: Filter for types of buildings to attack.

heatColor.doc: Color of heat region drawn on top (if found)

shootEffect.doc: Optional override for all shoot effects.

smokeEffect.doc: Optional override for all smoke effects.

ammoUseEffect.doc: Effect created when ammo is used. Not optional.

shootSound.doc: Sound emitted when a single bullet is shot.

chargeSound.doc: Sound emitted when shoot.firstShotDelay is >0 and shooting begins.

loopSound.doc: The sound that this block makes while active. One sound loop. Do not overuse.

soundPitchMin.doc: Range for pitch of shoot sound.

soundPitchMax.doc: Range for pitch of shoot sound.

ammoEjectBack.doc: Backwards Y offset of ammo eject effect.

linearWarmup.doc: If true, turret warmup is linear instead of a curve.

recoil.doc: Visual amount by which the turret recoils back per shot.

recoils.doc: Number of additional counters for recoil.

recoilTime.doc: ticks taken for turret to return to starting position in ticks. uses reload time by default

recoilPow.doc: power curve applied to visual recoil

cooldownTime.doc: ticks to cool down the heat region

elevation.doc: Visual elevation of turret shadow, -1 to use defaults.

shake.doc: How much the screen shakes per shot.

drawer.doc: Defines drawing behavior for this turret.
